messages:
Maya: Kicking off a 5% canary for entitlement-based routing today. Targeting tenants with tag:beta-entitlements.
Sam: Quick Q: how do quota overrides interact with the new entitlement filter? We changed routing earlier and I want to avoid double-counting.
Maya: Canary only flips routing policy. Quota evaluation still happens against the tenant's primary quota table. For canary tenants we attach scoped-token=true on service accounts.
Oliver: Risk: changed routing might move requests between backend shards and cause CPU imbalance. We should monitor shard CPU and request distribution.
Sam: Agreed. Need a telemetry card for route_affinity_delta + token_resolution_latency. @deploy-bot can you link the dashboard?
deploy-bot: Canary deployed to 42 tenants. Dashboard: https://console.redwood/dashboards/canary-entitlement-1757771212
John: Add a rollback feature-flag (FF_entitlement_fallback) and a playbook threshold: revert if route affinity CPU or p95 latency increases >15% over baseline.
Maya: Playbook excerpt: 
```
# start canary
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/internal/entitlements/canary -d '{"percent":5,"selector":"tag:beta-entitlements","rollback_threshold":0.15}'
```
Oliver: API question: internal endpoint now returns a session_scope header. Do Dedicated clusters need to see this header to make correct routing decisions?
Sam: Yes. Without header propagation metrics will show token resolved but routing will still use legacy principal. We need a migration gate: ensure Dedicated infra forwards session_scope before ramp past 20%.
Maya: Updated playbook: pause at 20% if header propagation not observed in 10/10 sampled canary tenants.
Lina: Telemetry proposal: new metric ent.route_affinity_change tagged by scope_version, model_variant, tenant_id. Also add ent.quota_override_count and ent.quota_denied_count. Add a trace span for token-resolution path.
Sam: Also track ent.session_scope_present boolean per request so we can measure propagation coverage.
deploy-bot: Alert created: ent_route_affinity_increase > 0.12 for 5m -> notify #eng-sre and oncall.
John: UX ask: console should show canary state per tenant and a one-click rollback in the tenant detail modal. Product?
Priya (product): We have a modal prototype but need microcopy for "why rolled back" and a small telemetry snapshot (recent spikes, example traces). I can draft.
Maya: Ramp plan: 5% -> monitor 45m -> 20% (pause/verify headers) -> 50% -> full. If header propagation missing at 20% we stop and coordinate infra.
Sam: I'll schedule Dedicated infra change window, ETA ~3h. I'll also add a health-check that validates session_scope in the request path.
Oliver: Indexing note: elastic index entitlement-events will add field session_scope; inform logging team about mapping update.
Lina: I'll stand up the dashboard cards and set trace sampling to 0.5% for canary tenants. Will post links when ready.
Maya: Team, reply here when your action items are done. :thumbsup:
Sam: Infra window booked for 12:30 UTC.
deploy-bot: Canary ramped to 20% at 1757771332
